title: philotheca myoporoides subsp. leichhardtii
intro: Philotheca myoporoides subsp. leichhardtii, commonly known as Lemon Myrtle, is a plant native to Australia that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Lemon Myrtle are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including citral, limonene, and linalool. The bioactive constituents of Lemon Myrtle have been shown to have a positive impact on mental health and well-being, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies and aromatherapy products.
